title: Sheinbaum to Brief Ayotzinapa Parents on Aguirre Detention, Anticipates More Arrests
detail: President Claudia Sheinbaum announced at her August 27, 2026 morning press conference that the special prosecutor for the Ayotzinapa case would brief the parents of the 43 disappeared students, in a meeting scheduled for later that week, on how investigators reached the August 6 detention of former Guerrero governor Ángel Aguirre. Sheinbaum said a previously unanalyzed set of phone records from the night of September 26, 2014 opened new investigative lines that led to the detention of individuals not previously investigated, and said further arrests were possible. She directed the Interior Secretariat to prepare a public report on the case's advances to be released before the September 26, 2026 twelfth anniversary of the disappearances.

media.caption: Infobae: Sheinbaum says Ayotzinapa parents will be briefed on Aguirre detention advances
